 This Friday evening, Paris Saint-Germain are away at Le Havre in the opening game of Ligue 1's ninth matchday.
 Maghnes Akliouche started the match in an unfamiliar, experimental position.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Having played on the right, on the left or through the middle of the attack since joining PSG this summer, the France international is playing as a holding midfielder this Friday evening, operating as a number 6 at the base of the Parisian midfield. In other words, in Vitinha's usual position!
 An unusual positional switch reminiscent of what Luis Enrique did with Lucas Beraldo, the centre-back converted into a number 6 by the PSG coach, and one that seems to be going down well with some observers on X...
